notes:
Ask for something "only if" — and now Crisp actually checks.

Type "if it's vertical, mute it" and Crisp looks at the clip before deciding. Until now the condition was ignored and the edit ran regardless, so a landscape clip got muted anyway. It now checks shape, sound, length and resolution, and tells you plainly when it skipped something and why. If you ask for a condition it cannot check from the file — "if it looks shaky" — it does what it always did and says so, rather than quietly guessing.
